CONSTRAINED_ACTION.criterion: A constrained action is formally defined only when the configuration space, constraint structure, action, consistency conditions, and constrained equation structure are identified. Multipliers stay undecided until the constraint structure requires them. A physical constraint is not chosen.

DISCRETE_DYNAMICAL_RULE.criterion: A discrete rule is formally defined only when the state space, transition rule, admissibility conditions, evolution index, and endpoint conditions are identified. A continuum density, a continuous measure, and a continuum limit are not required.

HAMILTONIAN_OR_CANONICAL_FORMULATION.criterion: A canonical formulation is formally defined only when the phase space, canonical variables, generator, and evolution equations are identified. Symplectic structure, constraints, constraint algebra, and gauge generators stay undecided until the generator requires them. A local action is not assumed to have one canonical image.

LOCAL_ACTION_FUNCTIONAL.criterion: A local action is formally defined only when the configuration space, fields, domain, required geometry, measure, symbolic scalar density, derivative order, admitted-term family, symmetries, boundary data, and functional variation are identified. Coefficients, when required, stay symbols. No particular action is selected.
LOCAL_ACTION_FUNCTIONAL.multiple_invariant_bases: recorded as an ambiguity and left unselected

NOT_YET_SPECIFIABLE.criterion: The object type itself is unregistered. That obstacle stays a missing mathematical definition and is not relabelled as a missing finite window.
NOT_YET_SPECIFIABLE.finite_algebra: multiplication presentation remains undefined; no algebra is selected

OTHER_FORMAL_DYNAMICS.criterion: The formulation stays in this class until a registered mathematical object identifies the generator. No conversion into another class is performed.

RENORMALIZATION_FLOW.criterion: A flow is formally defined only when the coupling space, its coordinates, the scaling map, the flow parameter, the flow map, and initial conditions are identified. A scheme, a numerical cutoff, a dimensional reduction, and a distinguished fixed point are not assumed.

STATE_SUM_OR_TRANSITION_AMPLITUDE.criterion: A state sum is formally defined only when the configuration set, admissibility rule, weight, amplitude, sum, boundary data, and transition rule are separately identified. An exponential of an action is not assumed.

conclusion: For each registered dynamical class, the audit states which mathematical conditions are required before a formulation can be called formally defined, and which further conditions remain before any finite dynamical search.
